transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; could you tell me what brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um... I guess I'm here because... well, for the past year or so, I've just been having some trouble staying on track. 

The smallest thing just... pulls me off what I'm doing before I can stop it. Like a phone buzz, or... somebody walking past my office. Or even just a random thought about my in-laws. It just... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Looking back at your childhood or your time in school, did you struggle with these same kinds of distractions back then?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I mean, back then... teachers were always moving my seat around. Just... saying I talked too much, or I'd get up without asking. Or I'd blurt things out before they even finished a question. So... yeah. I suppose it was there back then, too.
